title: Save Our Springs Legal Battle & Hospital Probe
summary:
*   **Environmental Lawsuit Focus:** Legal review of the South Austin Outfall project and ongoing litigation from environmental groups like Save Our Springs.
*   **Brackenridge Hospital Scrutiny:** Discussed legal aspects related to an investigation into Brackenridge Hospital.
*   **City Financial Contract:** Received legal advice concerning a credit reconciliation contract with a financial services company.
